comparable_criterion: proposed contribution lives in the same bounded (0,1] space as every existing relation, is quiet on clean data, and moves on fault -- checked without consulting any scored outcome

frozen_transform.downstream_map: consistency(lam) = exp(-0.5*max(0, lam-1)), csia/trust_engine/engine.py -- bounded in (0,1], so the contribution CANNOT dominate the score by unit choice regardless of lam's magnitude. This is a structural guarantee, not a tuned one
frozen_transform.h0_source: SIM_GPS1_ACC (0.3 m) * 1000 -- the DECLARED nominal receiver accuracy of the configuration under test
frozen_transform.kappa_h_rationale: a declared LOG SCALE, NOT a standard deviation: one doubling of reported horizontal uncertainty above nominal is one normalized degradation unit. The earlier name `sigma` implied an empirical spread that was never estimated and that the data cannot support -- clean SITL h_acc is constant
frozen_transform.lam: EWMA_0.15((resid/sigma)^2), identical in form to OnlineTrustLayer._lam_upd(df=1) so the units match every existing relation by construction
frozen_transform.residual_rationale: one-sided because better-than-nominal accuracy is not a fault; logarithmic because h_acc spans three decades

saturation.CORRECTION: an earlier report said 2.8x nominal. Wrong: 2.9176x is the ratio near consistency 0.5, and the 0.01 threshold is 9.16x. Derived in tests/test_maer_hacc_transform.py rather than quoted

units: all four distributions below are consistency scores in (0,1]; higher means MORE consistent, so a fault drives the score DOWN
why: a contribution reported in millimetres must not dominate the score by unit choice; the Stage 0.5 MAD-floor form is withdrawn

withdrawn_transform.defect: clean SITL h_acc is constant so MAD is 0; the floor is an arbitrary 1000x gain and would let the research arm win on scaling rather than information
